description: Global design tokens + core UI primitives upgrade. Update globals.css to add the full cyberpunk token set (darker bg values #050508/#0d0d18/#111127, neon accent shades, scanline/grid overlay keyframes, glitch keyframes, status-bar token classes, neon-text/neon-border utilities). Extend tailwind.config.ts with matching colour aliases and new keyframes. Upgrade GlassCard, GlowButton, Badge, AnimatedCounter, and StatusPulse with enhanced cyberpunk variants, neon-glow on hover, and new props. Add new shared UI components: CyberBreadcrumb, StatusBar (SHARD/TICK/SYNCED), NeonText, ScanlineOverlay. Extend src/lib/motion.ts with glitchReveal, scanIn, counterPop variants.
steps: 1. Read and understand apps/web/src/app/globals.css (already explored — CSS vars, keyframes, glass-card, tournament-card-glow, live-indicator, podium, rank-change utilities). Upgrade in-place: change --color-bg-primary to #050508, --color-bg-secondary to #0d0d18, --color-bg-card to #111127; add --color-bg-hud:#0a0a14, --color-neon-violet:#7c3aed, --color-neon-cyan:#06b6d4, --color-neon-red:#ef4444, --color-neon-green:#22c55e, --color-neon-amber:#f59e0b; add @keyframes glitch-clip (clips text layer for glitch effect), @keyframes scanline (vertical scan animation for overlay), @keyframes grid-scroll (scrolling grid bg), @keyframes hud-slide-in (status-bar entrance), @keyframes data-flicker (random opacity flicker for terminal text); add .scanline-overlay, .hud-grid-bg, .neon-text-violet, .neon-text-cyan, .neon-border-violet, .neon-border-cyan, .glitch-text utility classes. File: apps/web/src/app/globals.css

2. Extend apps/web/tailwind.config.ts: add keyframes for glitch-clip, scanline, hud-slide-in, data-flicker, grid-scroll to the keyframes block; add animation aliases (glitch:'glitch-clip 0.4s steps(2,end) infinite', scanline:'scanline 8s linear infinite', hud-slide-in:'hud-slide-in 0.3s ease-out', data-flicker:'data-flicker 3s step-start infinite'); add text-glow, border-glow boxShadow utilities in the extend block; ensure all existing colours (obsidian, graphite, electric, cyan, silver) are preserved. File: apps/web/tailwind.config.ts

3. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx: add new optional props neonColor ('violet'|'cyan'|'red'|'green', default undefined), scanline (boolean, default false), hud (boolean, default false). When neonColor is set, apply matching neon-border-* class and glow box-shadow on hover. When scanline is true, render the .scanline-overlay pseudo-element via a child div. When hud is true, apply .hud-grid-bg and a thin top border stripe in neon cyan. Preserve all existing props and behaviour. File: apps/web/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx

4. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/ui/GlowButton.tsx: add new variant 'cyber' (cyan gradient with violet glow on hover, monospace font label). Add a subtle shimmer animation span inside primary and cyber variants using the existing shimmer keyframe. Ensure the asChild span wrapper preserves the new classes. File: apps/web/src/components/ui/GlowButton.tsx

5. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx: add new variants 'cyber' (cyan/dark bg, mono font) and 'warning' (amber). For 'live' variant add a second CSS class live-indicator so it uses the existing pulsing ::before dot from globals.css instead of the inline span. File: apps/web/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx

6. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/ui/AnimatedCounter.tsx: wrap the output span in a motion.span with a scale pop animation on count complete (scaleIn variant from lib/motion.ts). Add optional monospace prop (boolean) that applies font-mono class. File: apps/web/src/components/ui/AnimatedCounter.tsx
7. Upgrade apps/web/src/components/ui/StatusPulse.tsx: add 'critical' variant (red + fast pulse at 0.5s) and 'warning' variant (amber + pulse). File: apps/web/src/components/ui/StatusPulse.tsx

8. Create apps/web/src/components/ui/CyberBreadcrumb.tsx: a client component that reads usePathname(), splits on '/', maps each segment to a label (handles [guildId]→server name prop, [tournamentId]→tournament name prop via optional label overrides object), and renders a chevron-separated trail with neon-text-cyan colour on the active crumb. Uses Orbitron font and JetBrains Mono for path segments. Props: labels?: Record<string,string>, className?: string.

9. Create apps/web/src/components/ui/StatusBar.tsx: a client component rendering a fixed horizontal HUD strip at bottom of viewport (or top — use bottom-0 fixed). Shows: SHARD indicator (online/offline StatusPulse + label), TICK counter (increments every second using setInterval, shows frames since load as a 6-digit zero-padded mono number), SYNCED indicator (StatusPulse synced + 'SYNCED'), current UTC time in HH:MM:SS mono, and an optional custom left slot via children prop. Styled with .hud-grid-bg background, 1px neon-border-cyan top border, small text in JetBrains Mono.

10. Create apps/web/src/components/ui/NeonText.tsx: simple presentational component. Props: as ('h1'|'h2'|'h3'|'p'|'span', default 'span'), color ('violet'|'cyan'|'red'|'green'), glitch (boolean — adds glitch-text class and data-text={children} attribute for CSS glitch layer), children, className. Uses Orbitron for headings, JetBrains Mono for span/p.

11. Extend apps/web/src/lib/motion.ts: add glitchReveal variant (opacity 0→1 with a brief x jitter: hidden:{opacity:0,x:-4,skewX:2}, visible:{opacity:1,x:0,skewX:0,transition:{duration:0.4}}), scanIn variant (clipPath reveal from top: hidden:{clipPath:'inset(0 0 100% 0)'}, visible:{clipPath:'inset(0 0 0% 0)',transition:{duration:0.5,ease:[0.16,1,0.3,1]}}), counterPop variant (scale 0.8→1 with bounce: hidden:{scale:0.8,opacity:0}, visible:{scale:1,opacity:1,transition:{type:'spring',stiffness:300,damping:20}}). File: apps/web/src/lib/motion.ts
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter web type-check exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
GlassCard renders with neonColor='violet' prop without errors
GlowButton renders with variant='cyber' without errors
Badge renders with variant='cyber' and variant='warning' without errors
CyberBreadcrumb, StatusBar, NeonText components export correctly and are importable
New CSS keyframes (glitch-clip, scanline, hud-slide-in, data-flicker, grid-scroll) exist in globals.css
tailwind.config.ts animation aliases reference those keyframes
findings: All 11 steps implemented and verified. New components (CyberBreadcrumb, StatusBar, NeonText) export from src/components/ui/. New motion variants (glitchReveal, scanIn, counterPop) exported from src/lib/motion.ts. CSS variables updated: --color-bg-primary=#050508, --color-bg-secondary=#0d0d18, --color-bg-card=#111127, --color-bg-hud=#0a0a14 plus full neon palette. Keyframes glitch-clip, scanline, grid-scroll, hud-slide-in, data-flicker added to both globals.css and tailwind.config.ts. GlassCard gains neonColor/scanline/hud props; GlowButton gains cyber variant + shimmer; Badge gains cyber/warning variants; AnimatedCounter gains monospace prop; StatusPulse gains critical/warning variants. Later steps can import all new primitives from @/components/ui/.
